notes:
Vertices on the planning map can now be moved: drag a corner to fine
tune the area and the survey redraws as you go. Tap a corner and the
UNDO button turns into ERASE to remove just that one. UNDO now walks
back any edit — a point added, moved or erased, or a clear — and
clearing the whole area takes a two second hold on the same button.

Bore sight: hold the Survey card for five seconds when starting a
new plan to lay out a bore sight and a survey as one mission, takeoff
to landing. The survey is flown on from the bore sight's finish.

A manual mode change mid-flight now flashes the new mode over the
map so it cannot be missed, and GUIDED shows as AUTO.
